# xyops_plugin (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "xyops_plugin" "hello_shell" {
  title       = "Hello Shell"
  enabled     = true
  type        = "event"
  script_file = "#!/bin/sh\necho hello"
  command     = "sh"
  format      = "text"
  groups      = []
  params      = jsonencode([])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `script_file` (String)
- `title` (String)
- `type` (String)

### Optional

- `command` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `format` (String)
- `gid` (Number)
- `groups` (List of String)
- `params` (String)
- `uid` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import xyops_plugin.hello_shell hello_shell
```
